comment: Speech models offered in the Speech Lab. Paths are relative to the project folder. peakMb: highest process memory measured 2026-11-23 on speaker s1 or synthetic speech; not a limit. None of these has passed the accuracy target.

models.name: Whisper tiny + generated prompt
models.note: Best so far on one speaker (86 of 102 fields). Text after release; delay not re-measured.

models.name: Whisper tiny + prompt
models.note: Earlier prompt (78 of 102 fields). Text after release.

models.name: Vosk small, limited words
models.note: Fastest. Drops digits on one speaker (37 of 102 fields).

models.name: Vosk small, all words
models.note: Poor on aviation wording (8 of 102 fields).

models.name: Whisper tiny, no prompt
models.note: About 3 s after release (39 of 102 fields).

models.name: Whisper base + prompt
models.note: Not better than tiny so far (76 of 102 fields). Delay not yet measured.
